title: Analyzing multisensory integration: Do’s and don’ts
title_zh: 多感官整合分析：应做与不应做的指南
abstract: Multisensory perception is a cornerstone paradigm for understanding how the brain constructs coherent representations of the world from noisy, fragmented sensory inputs. For decades, researchers have used the magnitude of crossmodal illusions, the width of the temporal binding window, and related behavioral indices as direct proxies for 'integration strength,' and have leveraged these measures to compare multisensory function across developmental, clinical, and aging populations. Here we argue that this descriptive practice is frequently compromised: behavioral readouts of multisensory integration are composite measures jointly shaped by unisensory precision, amodal priors, and the binding process itself, and cannot be interpreted in isolation. Drawing on simulations within a Bayesian Causal Inference framework, we show how identical behavioral patterns can arise from very different underlying causes, leading to systematic misattribution of group differences to 'deficits' or 'enhancements' in integration. We review complementary computational frameworks, including coupling priors, drift diffusion, multisensory correlation detection, and statistical facilitation models, and outline their respective explanatory limits. Finally, we provide a model-based inference pipeline, from experimental design and unisensory baselines to parameter estimation and interpretation, that aims to help disentangles sensory fidelity, prior expectations, and integrative tendency. Adopting this normative approach can facilitate cumulative progress in basic multisensory research and for its translation to neuropsychiatric assessment, lifespan research, and artificial perceptual systems.
abstract_zh: 多感官感知是理解大脑如何从嘈杂、碎片化的感官输入中构建连贯世界表征的基石范式。数十年来，研究者利用跨模态错觉的幅度、时间绑定窗口的宽度及相关行为指标作为“整合强度”的直接代理，并借此比较发展、临床和老龄人群的多感官功能。我们认为，这种描述性做法常常受到损害：多感官整合的行为读数是由单感官精度、无模态先验和绑定过程共同塑造的复合指标，无法单独解释。通过在贝叶斯因果推断框架内的模拟，我们展示了相同的行为模式如何源自截然不同的潜在原因，导致系统性地将组间差异错误归因于“缺陷”或“增强”的整合。我们回顾了补充的计算框架，包括耦合先验、漂移扩散、多感官相关检测和统计促进模型，并阐述了它们各自的解释局限。最后，我们提供了一个基于模型的推断流程，从实验设计和单感官基线到参数估计与解释，旨在帮助分离感官保真度、先验期望和整合倾向。采用这种规范化方法可促进基础多感官研究的累积进展，并推动其在神经精神评估、寿命研究和人工感知系统中的转化。
